title: The Deadline of Tashkent
author: Wendell Quintana
blurb: Isandro Crane, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
